utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Good morning to everyone in and around the courtroom. Madam Registrar, could you call the case, please.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. This is the case IT-04-75-T, the Prosecutor versus Goran Hadzic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Could we have the appearances, please, starting with the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MR. STRINGER
utterances.text: Good morning, Mr. President, Your Honours. For the Prosecution, Douglas Stringer, Alex Demirdjian, Thomas Laugel, and Lucia Laporte.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Zivanovic, for the Defence.

utterances.speaker: MR. ZIVANOVIC
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honours. For the Defence of Goran Hadzic, Zoran Zivanovic, Christopher Gosnell, and Liane Aronchick, legal assistant.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Thank you very much. I'll take a moment for a oral ruling. The Defence requested the admission of a number of documents used to challenge the credibility of GH-026 during cross-examination on the 13th of June, 2013. Documents with Rule 65 ter number 1D413, 1D416, and 1D418 relate to a criminal conviction. Documents with Rule 65 ter number 1D415, 1D421, 1D423, 1D426, and 1D427 relate to a criminal investigation. The document with Rule 65 ter number 05686 consists of medical records. In view of the evidence elicited from the witness on cross-examination, the Trial Chamber does not consider it necessary the admission of further supporting material relating to the criminal investigation or medical records. However, documents with Rule 65 ter number 1D413, 1D416, and 1D418, relating to the criminal conviction will be admitted under seal because they substantially supplement the questioning during the cross-examination and will assist the Trial Chamber in assessing the evidence of the witness during its final deliberations in the present case. Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, those will be Exhibit numbers D75, D76, and D77, under seal.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Your Honours, in addition to that, in an internal memorandum dated 26 June 2013, 65 ter 02601 was assigned Exhibit Number P2265.2186. And 65 ter 02990 was assigned Exhibit Number P2269.2186. Those are the two documents the Prosecution actually sought to exclude from the 92 ter package and therefore should not have been assigned numbers.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, could you check on the record the first exhibit number. I think the -- the number after the dot is not correct.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: The Exhibit Number should be P2265.2186.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Okay. Perhaps it's just fell off the screen. Thank you. The witness may be brought in. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
utterances.text: Yes, closed session, please. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE DELVOIE
